def iter_base_model_classes(output_type: Any) -> list[type]:

    Handles plain classes, ``Union``/``Optional`` types, and generic containers
    such as ``list`` and ``dict`` by recursively inspecting their type arguments.
    Returns an empty list for non-``BaseModel`` types such as ``str`` or ``int``.
